title: Expressing Transformation: automatizálttá válik, fontossá válik

sections.title: Translative Transformations with válni
sections.content: You know *-vá/-vé* with *válik* from A2 Unit 35 and *tesz* from Unit 19. Technology talk uses it for lasting change: *A távmunka elterjedtté vált.* (Remote work has become widespread.) *A digitális írástudás fontossá válik.* (Digital literacy is becoming important.)

items.spanish: Az okostelefon a mindennapi élet fontos részévé vált.
items.english: The smartphone has become an important part of everyday life.

items.spanish: Sok monoton irodai munka mára teljesen automatizálttá lett.
items.english: Many monotonous office jobs have by now become completely automated.
